flags.model_excerpt: कोई बात नहीं आप इंस्टाग्राम पे आ सकते हो मेरे नाम क्या है इंस्टाग्राम
flags.model_translation: No problem, can you come on Instagram? What is your Instagram name?
flags.model_justification: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Instagram).
flags.model_context: The user asks the expert to move to Instagram. The expert initially refuses.

flags.model_excerpt: मैं बोल रहा हूँ ना किसी चीज़ का कमी नहीं होगा आपकी तो आ जाओ ना इंस्टा पे आ जाओ वहीं बात करेंगे
flags.model_translation: I am telling you, you won't lack anything, so come on Insta, we will talk there.
flags.model_justification: The user is actively proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Instagram).
flags.model_context: The user continues to pressure the expert to move to Instagram after the expert expressed hesitation.

flags.model_excerpt: प्रिया राज प्रिया राज डबल एट डबल जीरो
flags.model_translation: Priya Raj Priya Raj double eight double zero
flags.model_justification: The user is providing an external social media handle to move the conversation off-platform.
flags.model_context: The user provides their Instagram handle/ID to the expert.
